crates/guards/chio-external-guards/src/e: Shared 1 MiB original JSON owner: native arguments preserve full-width integers; provider responses use strict external I-JSON before projection. Typed parser causes are redacted by core wrappers.
All six provider guards use the egress contract actual-response retention bound and one strict original JSON response parser. HTTP status errors expose status/provider, not response body text.
crates/guards/chio-guard-registry/src/in: Regular-file reader checks metadata and bounded actual read; Unix final symlinks and nonregular files reject. External JSON helper gates original 16 MiB data before typed projection.
crates/guards/chio-guard-registry/src/do: All guard artifact downloads use digest-pinned 16 MiB manifest transport and preflight exact three-layer descriptor shapes/digests, 64 MiB aggregate config/layer size, and 16 MiB JSON-layer limits. Each actual streamed blob body is capped to its descriptor, then checked for exact size and hash before construction. SDK unbounded pull paths are removed.
crates/guards/chio-guard-registry/src/pu: Cache pull obtains raw manifest bytes through the bounded digest-verified transport and uses the same bounded artifact reader. Cache admission and separate Sigstore verification gates remain.
crates/guards/chio-guard-registry/src/ve: Cached Sigstore bundle and artifact bytes use bounded regular-file custody before existing attestation verification. Native Sigstore JSON input causes are forwarded without string flattening. No input decoding is treated as proof.
crates/guards/chio-guards/src/input.rs: Regular-file helper caps metadata and actual read before retention and rejects Unix final symlinks/nonregular files. Parent directory custody remains a deployment boundary.
crates/guards/chio-wasm-guards/src/input: Shared regular-file custody caps metadata and actual retention; original native JSON decoder preserves native integers and rejects duplicates. ManifestYamlError keeps the native YAML cause behind redacted Debug/Display.
crates/core/chio-core-types/src/canonica: Shared wrapper keeps original text until its chosen contract is enforced: strict external I-JSON before typed projection, duplicate-aware lossless native decode, or exact canonical typed equality. Safe Debug/Display retain native local sources. Callers own byte limits and authentication. Unsigned document decoding shares the original duplicate-aware value visitor but permits ordinary Serde numeric coercions for approximate embedding vectors. Existing signed, external and canonical numeric contracts are unchanged and explicitly required for authoritative records.
